Any source hash or registered row change must reject.
A changed candidate census, trace or certificate must reject.
Target access, fitting, uncertainty rescaling or aggregate-as-law conflation must reject.
A deliberately displaced direct angle or compatible W value must reject rather than become a passing label.

dimension_unit_boundary.external_reference_protocol: Mass units cancel only in the post-seal like-dimension ratio; no external unit enters formal forcing.

evaluation_protocol.acceptance_condition: Both like-typed measured-value intervals contain the sealed exact relation; every source and methodology row remains unchanged; no inconsistent aggregate is promoted to a physical target.
evaluation_protocol.falsification_condition: Reject if either source changes; the sealed exact share leaves the direct on-shell interval; its complement leaves the compatible W/Z squared interval; any uncertainty is widened; the inconsistent aggregate is deleted, used as a second law, or relabelled as an SFT result; or target data alter the formal survivor.

frozen_relation.candidate_grammar: Generate the complete eight-axis product of the sealed terminal electroweak value, like-typed direct measurements, exact interval transport, source consistency, custody, proof/measurement separation, successor closure and extension.
frozen_relation.exact_domain: The admitted target-free terminal on-shell value; the complete direct on-shell row; the complete compatible W and Z rows; the unchanged internally inconsistent all-input aggregation record; both source identities; and every measurement-method boundary.
frozen_relation.statement: The exact forced terminal on-shell share lies inside the complete PDG interval [22333,22351]/100000. Its exact complement lies inside the outward-propagated compatible-input W/Z squared interval. No uncertainty is widened and no inconsistent aggregate is converted into a passing or failing SFT law.

stop_condition: Halt without admission on a changed source, missed like-typed interval, altered method record, target access, fitting, uncertainty rescaling or failed control.
